scenes.label: BAD CAREER MOVE
scenes.text: What if Naruto joined the Akatsuki? Oh, fantastic.

shots.narration_beat: What if Naruto joined the Akatsuki? Oh, fantastic.
shots.match_reason: Naruto is shown as the hypothetical protagonist.

scenes.label: THE CLOAK IS A RED FLAG
scenes.text: Our boy saw matching villain cloaks and thought, career opportunity.

shots.narration_beat: Our boy saw matching villain cloaks and thought, career opportunity.
shots.match_reason: The cloaked Akatsuki group illustrates the organization and costume joke.

scenes.label: YOU ARE THE TARGET
scenes.text: Motherflicker, they are hunting the fox inside you.

shots.narration_beat: Motherflicker, they are hunting the fox inside you.
shots.match_reason: Kurama visibly illustrates the fox being sought; this is the actual motive behind the joke.

scenes.label: NOT AN INTERVIEW
scenes.text: That is not a job interview. You are the lunch.

shots.narration_beat: That is not a job interview. You are the lunch.
shots.match_reason: Naruto reaction shot supports the sarcastic target/recruit comparison; no literal eating is claimed.

scenes.label: A MADE-UP DEAL
scenes.text: In this made-up timeline, he bargains for his friends' safety.

shots.narration_beat: In this made-up timeline, he bargains for his friends' safety.
shots.match_reason: Team Seven illustrates the friends whose safety motivates the invented deal.

scenes.label: SUSPICIOUS MANAGEMENT
scenes.text: Fine. But the cloak comes with suspiciously aggressive management.

shots.narration_beat: Fine. But the cloak comes with suspiciously aggressive management.
shots.match_reason: Masked Obito supplies an actual Akatsuki antagonist for the management metaphor.

scenes.label: PEACE WITH A DEMOLITION NOTICE
scenes.text: Pain calls it peace. The village gets a demolition notice.

shots.narration_beat: Pain calls it peace. The village gets a demolition notice.
shots.match_reason: Pain above the Leaf directly illustrates the speaker, village and destruction threat.

scenes.label: CAN WE TALK FIRST
scenes.text: Naruto says, can we maybe try a conversation first?

shots.narration_beat: Naruto says, can we maybe try a conversation first?
shots.match_reason: Naruto illustrates an imagined dialogue response; this is not canonical quoted dialogue.

scenes.label: ACCOUNTABILITY OFF
scenes.text: And Obito? Mask on. Accountability off. Absolutely excellent hiring department.

shots.narration_beat: And Obito? Mask on. Accountability off. Absolutely excellent hiring department.
shots.match_reason: Obito in his mask directly matches the named character and visual punchline.

scenes.label: FINALLY SOME RESPECT
scenes.text: At first, missions go well. Our boy finally feels respected.

shots.narration_beat: At first, missions go well. Our boy finally feels respected.
shots.match_reason: Naruto action footage illustrates the invented successful mission stage.

scenes.label: THE REAL ASSIGNMENT
scenes.text: Then comes the assignment: betray the Hidden Leaf.

shots.narration_beat: Then comes the assignment: betray the Hidden Leaf.
shots.match_reason: The Leaf in the Pain shot illustrates the village endangered in the hypothetical demand.

scenes.label: READ THE CONTRACT
scenes.text: Brother. That is your home. Read the stupid contract.

shots.narration_beat: Brother. That is your home. Read the stupid contract.
shots.match_reason: A Naruto reaction shot illustrates the narrator addressing him; no literal contract footage is claimed.

scenes.label: HE REFUSES
scenes.text: He refuses. Suddenly the new team questions his loyalty.

shots.narration_beat: He refuses. Suddenly the new team questions his loyalty.
shots.match_reason: Naruto illustrates the hypothetical refusal and internal conflict.

scenes.label: SOME PROTECTION PLAN
scenes.text: Sakura is left picking through rubble. Some protection plan.

shots.narration_beat: Sakura is left picking through rubble. Some protection plan.
shots.match_reason: Sakura amid the devastated village directly illustrates the consequence described; its causality here is invented.

scenes.label: OLD FRIENDS, NEW DOUBTS
scenes.text: Even his old friends cannot tell whose side he is on.

shots.narration_beat: Even his old friends cannot tell whose side he is on.
shots.match_reason: Team Seven directly illustrates the old friends and the hypothetical loyalty dilemma.

scenes.label: TWO TEAMS. ZERO TRUST.
scenes.text: Congratulations, genius. Two teams, zero trust, absolutely no dental insurance.

shots.narration_beat: Congratulations, genius. Two teams, zero trust, absolutely no dental insurance.
shots.match_reason: Naruto reaction shot supports the sarcastic evaluation; dental insurance is explicitly a joke.

scenes.label: CHOOSE YOUR PEOPLE
scenes.text: So he stops chasing approval and chooses his people.

shots.narration_beat: So he stops chasing approval and chooses his people.
shots.match_reason: Team Seven illustrates the friends he chooses in the hypothetical resolution.

scenes.label: WEAPON OR ARGUMENT
scenes.text: The Akatsuki wanted a weapon. They got an argument.

shots.narration_beat: The Akatsuki wanted a weapon. They got an argument.
shots.match_reason: Akatsuki members directly match the named group; argument is a hypothetical characterization.

scenes.label: COULD HE CHANGE THEM
scenes.text: Could he actually change them? Maybe. This is Naruto.

shots.narration_beat: Could he actually change them? Maybe. This is Naruto.
shots.match_reason: Naruto is shown when the closing question returns to him.

scenes.label: THE GROUP PROJECT FROM HELL
scenes.text: But friendship speeches cannot fix every murderous group project.

shots.narration_beat: But friendship speeches cannot fix every murderous group project.
shots.match_reason: The cloaked organization illustrates the villainous group being compared with a disastrous project.

scenes.label: KEEP OR CONFISCATE THE CLOAK
scenes.text: Would you trust his plan, or confiscate the cloak immediately?

shots.narration_beat: Would you trust his plan, or confiscate the cloak immediately?
shots.match_reason: Naruto closes the hypothetical with the audience choice; no literal cloak removal is depicted.

review_method: Existing reviewed source clips selected by concrete spoken beat. Scene cuts retimed to actual generated speech; invented causality and jokes remain illustrative.
